headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.
The reading fell short of a projection of 3.98 per cent from economists polled by financial data provider Wind. On a...

headlines.title_en: Friday (August 7) NY tail end: US 10-year Treasury yield rose 5.14 basis points to 4.690%. At 20:30 Beijing time, upon release of July US retail sales data, it surged from the daily low of 4.628%.
headlines.summary_en: At the New York close on Friday (August 7), the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose 5.14 basis points to 4.690%, surging from the day's low of 4.628% when U.S. July retail sales data was released at 20:30 Beijing time. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 2.88 basis points to 4.169%, down 2.40 basis points for the week. The 20-year Treasury yield rose 5.22 basis points to 5.257%, up 5.10 basis points for the week; the 30-year Treasury yield rose 5.96 basis points for the week to 5.259%.

headlines.title_en: Friday (August 14) NY tail end: International precious metals futures closed mixed.
headlines.summary_en: At the New York close on Friday (August 14), international precious metals futures closed mixed. Spot gold fell first then rose, up 0.6% on the day to $4,375.67/oz, up 0.81% for the week. COMEX gold futures rose 0.26% to $4,432.00/oz, up 0.73% for the week. Weakening U.S. economic data cooled Fed rate-hike expectations, coupled with Middle East geopolitical uncertainty and central bank net purchases underpinning gold, jointly supported prices. Spot silver rose 0.40% to $64.667/oz, up over 1.8% for the week. COMEX silver futures fell 0.26% to $64.83/oz, up 2.09% for the week.

headlines.title_en: Fed's Goolsbee said he supports the decision to hold rates steady in July.
headlines.summary_en: Fed's Goolsbee said he supports the decision to hold rates steady in July. He noted that the recent two productivity readings were unsatisfactory, and if productivity continues to decline, the Fed may need to reassess market expectations for artificial intelligence (AI). Goolsbee said the latest CPI data was encouraging, but more data is needed before making a judgment; persistent consumer weakness is concerning, though weak retail sales are only a single-month performance so far. Meanwhile, U.S. GDP and the labor market remain broadly stable overall.

headlines.title_en: CALB expects H1 net profit at least to double, driven by expansion of new customers and new application scenarios.
headlines.summary_en: CALB released its 2026 interim results forecast. The announcement shows that for the first half of the year, the company expects net profit of approximately RMB 1.506 billion to RMB 1.581 billion, up about 100% to 110% year-over-year. In the same period last year, CALB's net profit was approximately RMB 753 million. The company said the year-over-year profit increase was mainly driven by expansion into new customers and application scenarios, as well as continued volume growth of new products in passenger, commercial, and energy storage segments, with business scale steadily expanding.
